text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sakura Bakushin O's name has been
growing in
popularity.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, shortly after receiving her
signature
racewear...

text_block_list.name: Public Relations Committee Chief
text_block_list.text: Excuse me! Is anyone there?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Oh, a visitor?

text_block_list.name: Public Relations Committee Chief
text_block_list.text:
Hello! I am the head of the Public
Relations
Committee.

text_block_list.name: Public Relations Committee Chief
text_block_list.text:
For next month's issue, we want to write
an article
about some of the newly
debuted signature
racewear this season.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Are you gonna do a piece on me?! Like
an
interview?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
And I'm being asked by a chief!
Someone high up
on the hierarchy just
like yours truly! Hoho,
there's no way I
can refuse!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Can I do it, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Well, increasing her media coverage
would be a
good thing.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Among Sakura Bakushin O's classmates
are some
strong contenders including
Rice Shower, Mihono
Bourbon, and
Nishino Flower.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I should be proactive in promoting and
raising her
reputation so she doesn't fall
behind.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Yay! I'm gonna charm their socks off!
choice_data_list: Yeah, let's agree to the interview.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Right! We Umamusume shine the most
when we're
on the track!
choice_data_list: Shall we let our running do the talking?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Let's head to the training grounds! Come
and see
me running in my signature
racewear!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She grabs her signature racewear and
sprints
outside without another
moment's hesitation.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I apologize to the chief and the
committee
members left behind in her
wake and together we
follow after
Sakura Bakushin O.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Heh heh! How about it? Looking on
point and
elegant from head to toe,
aren't I?

text_block_list.name: Public Relations Committee Chief
text_block_list.text:
Fantastic! The cherry blossom design
totally suits
you!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Yes! And it looks even better once I
start
running! Just take a look!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: I'm off!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: You got it!
choice_data_list: Go Bakushin with all your might!
Go Bakushin with all your might!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I stand before you as the true Bakushin
O,
dressed in my signature racewear!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
HERE I BAKUSHIN! Step back and
witness my
reborn strength!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Haaa!

text_block_list.name: Public Relations Committee Chief
text_block_list.text:
What frightful speed! I think I finally get
what she
means by "Bakushin"! This truly
is the very peak of
running speed!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Heh heh! And this isn't even my final
form!
choice_data_list: That was the best run you've ever had!
That was your best run yet!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Time to go into OVERDRIVE!
BAKUUUSHIIIN!

text_block_list.name: Public Relations Committee Chief
text_block_list.text: Impossible! How can she go even faster?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Break the limits! Bakushin, BAKUSHIIIN!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff... I-I think that was a pretty good showing!

text_block_list.name: Public Relations Committee Member
text_block_list.text:
We managed to get some amazing
photos! This is
going to make for a great
article, Chief!

text_block_list.name: Public Relations Committee Chief
text_block_list.text:
It is indeed! How about this for a
headline... Fast
as a speeding bullet!
BAKUSHIN!

text_block_list.name: Public Relations Committee Chief
text_block_list.text:
Okay, I think we have everything we
need. Thank
you kindly for your
cooperation!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: No problem! Come back anytime!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With that, she drops down to the ground
with a
sigh.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She's hit her limit. It seems she still
hasn't
overcome her endurance issues.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Nevertheless, the article turns out great.
Sakura
Bakushin O's popularity begins to
rise by leaps
and bounds.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: I understand. Leave it to me!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to unleash all this surging
enthusiasm!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As they want to take photos as well,
Sakura
Bakushin O wears her signature
racewear for the
interview.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Thanks for waiting!

text_block_list.name: Public Relations Committee Chief
text_block_list.text:
Fantastic! The cherry blossom design
totally suits
you!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Hehe. I know, right?!

text_block_list.name: Public Relations Committee Chief
text_block_list.text:
I heard that you were the one who
requested the
cherry blossom motif?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Yep! My name is "Sakura" Bakushin O
after all!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
My destiny was decided the day I
received this
name.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Indeed! As vivid and elegant as the
cherry
blossoms in full bloom! I have to
keep pushing my
Bakushin to the limit!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
There is no design better suited to grace
my
signature racewear than the noble
cherry
blossom!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I will bloom gloriously, both as a racer
and class
representative!

text_block_list.name: Public Relations Committee Chief
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for that wonderful story. With
this,
we'll be able to write a great
article!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
No problem-o! Next, I'm going to tell
you all
about being class representative!

text_block_list.name: Public Relations Committee Chief
text_block_list.text:
H-huh? Y-you don't need to... We, uh,
can save
that for another day perhaps.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Don't be shy! I'll tell you all the details,
from start
to finish!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
...And so, that's how I began on the path
of being
the class representative!

text_block_list.name: Public Relations Committee Chief
text_block_list.text: I-is that so?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Always pure and honorable! I'll continue
to
Bakushin as the class representative!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
...And with that, Sakura Bakushin O's
interview
comes to an end.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The article turns out to be superb, and
the
public's perception of Sakura
Bakushin O
improves greatly.
